facts.fact: AidData record of the China Eximbank loans says Phase 2 of NOFBI construction activities began on 22 September 2014, financed by an RMB 460m loan signed 8 October 2012 for Huawei contracts to build 2,100 km of backbone.
AidData record says NOFBI Phase 2 (2,100 km of national optic fibre backbone passing through eight major towns and 36 districts) reached actual completion on 7 November 2020.
